message.content: I have rheumatoid arthritis, and for about five years I've also had a lung condition called interstitial lung disease that's been stable. I don't have asthma or COPD that I know of, and heart disease wasn't mentioned. For medicines, I take baricitinib and methotrexate for the arthritis, and my doses have been the same for a while. I was also exposed to asbestos material in the past. As for travel, sick contacts, birds or mold, nothing like that has come up, so I don't know of anything.
